Kit summary

Tearing PainBasic
Grants all allies 1 layer of [Demon Hunter Shield] by 15% of Telyss's Max HP, up to 4 layers. Afterward, deals 2 stages of [HP Burning] DMG by 22% of Telyss's Max HP each to a single enemy.
Giant Axe SlashesActiveExclusive Lv.1
Cleanses all Attribute Debuffs from all allies. Afterward, deals 3 stages of [HP Burning] DMG by 21% of Telyss's Max HP each to a single enemy and the 3rd stage also inflicts [Deep HP Burning II] on the target for 2 turns.
Demon Hunter's Axe Lv.1Each time Telyss enters [Resonance Enhancement] status, grants all allies [DMG Immunity] for 1 turn; starting from the 2nd time, whenever she enters [Resonance Enhancement] status, Telyss casts Giant Axe Slashes to pursue and attack the enemy with the lowest HP percentage currently once. For every 40% HP lost by any ally, increases Telyss's Turn Meter by 5%. This effect can be triggered up to 6 times before Telyss acts in the next turn.
Awakened Demon HunterPassiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Max Limit of Resonance Points: 20. When a battle starts, Telyss gains 14 points. When allies pursue and attack enemies, Telyss gains 1 Resonance Point and each ally can only grant Telyss 1 Resonance Point in this way during anyone's turn. When the Resonance Points reach the max limit, Telyss consumes all of them to enter [Resonance Enhancement] status for 2 turns, while under this status: 1. She cannot gain Resonance Points. 2. Replaces Time of Doom with Time of Doom · Resonance and resets its CD. 3. When an enemy's turn ends, Telyss will cast Tearing Pain to pursue and attack them once.
Demon Hunter's Axe Lv.2When Telyss is under [Resonance Enhancement] status, she can gain Resonance Points and is immune to control effects. At the beginning of each wave, if Telyss has the highest initial HP among all allies, she gains 6 Resonance Points.
Demon Hunter's Axe Lv.3Increases all allies' Max HP by 10% of Telyss's initial Max HP and additionally increases 20% for allies with the [Pursue & Attack] tag and allies with the [HP Burning] tag. At the beginning of each wave, for every 1 ally with the [Pursue & Attack] tag, reduces all allies' Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG taken by 20% for 1 turn.
Time of DoomActive
Grants all allies [Resolute II] for 2 turns. Afterward, deals 2 stages of [HP Burning] DMG by 20% of Telyss's Max HP each to all enemies. Will be replaced by Time of Doom · Resonance during the [Resonance Enhancement] status.
Source: game files.
